name: Norta
adoption_evidence: No adoption count corroborated
documented_features: Inventory, plans, monthly budget and optional read-only bank connection. Public mapper tested separately.
product_implication: Test its installed app before asserting a persistence or handover gap.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: Actual Budget
adoption_evidence: Popularity not quantified in this audit
documented_features: Envelope budgeting, recurring costs, imports, undo and optional encrypted sync. Public demo annual-cost task saved and survived reload.
product_implication: Do not rebuild a general envelope budgeter; preserve source/frequency clarity.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: Finanzguru
adoption_evidence: Company LinkedIn post claims over 3 million users; not independently audited
documented_features: Accounts, contracts, budgets, cancellation and AI money questions; provider screens and landing visual inspected, app not tested.
product_implication: A bank-linked financial assistant is already a substantial adjacent category; avoid copying its AI/brand.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: Outbank
adoption_evidence: 4500 supported institutions is coverage, not user adoption
documented_features: Provider describes local encrypted finance data, accounts, budgets, contracts and household book; 14-day trial.
product_implication: Local privacy is not novel by itself. Inspect actual exports and debt representation later.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: finanzblick
adoption_evidence: Provider states over 1 million downloads; not active users
documented_features: Accounts, categorisation, budgets, digital documents, payments and tax links. Provider screenshots are not hands-on evidence.
product_implication: Document organisation also overlaps; a generic document cabinet does not justify Maze Bank.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: Wallet by BudgetBakers
adoption_evidence: Provider homepage states 14M+ downloads; not active users
documented_features: Budgeting, expenses and bank synchronisation; adjacent family/personal finance. Homepage ratings and testimonials are provider-selected.
product_implication: Test manual-only onboarding and export rather than assume bank connection mandatory.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: YNAB
adoption_evidence: Provider states 104k app reviews; self-reported survey outcomes
documented_features: Money allocation and flexible goals, irregular-income positioning and 34-day trial. Published savings/stress claims derive from provider survey/testimonials.
product_implication: Do not interpret selective surveys as causal outcomes or transfer them to Germany debt counselling.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: Spendee
adoption_evidence: Provider states 4.7 App Store rating; scale/date not established
documented_features: Manual cash, bank and crypto wallets, budgets, shared wallets, currencies, reminders and backup. Some marketing examples are dated 2018.
product_implication: Differentiate claims from transactions; verify current installed workflows before feature-absence claims.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: Toshl Finance
adoption_evidence: Provider says trusted by millions; metric not defined
documented_features: Bank/manual entries, flow views, budgets, file imports and multiple platforms. Testimonials are not controlled effectiveness evidence.
product_implication: Good entry speed matters; flow graphics alone do not address uncertain claims.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: MoneyWiz
adoption_evidence: No adoption count corroborated
documented_features: Provider sample screens show accounts, budgets, bills and reports; manual accounts and imports. Forecast excludes scheduled items without amounts.
product_implication: Expose missing amounts in preparation totals rather than silently imply completeness.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: PocketGuard
adoption_evidence: App Store listing claims 1.7M+ users; not independent audit
documented_features: Premium debt plan, goals, imports/exports, split transactions and receipts. US/Canada/UK bank support stated in store listing; Germany support not established.
product_implication: Avoid presenting arithmetic difference as safe spending or prescribing loan priority.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: Fudget
adoption_evidence: Provider claims 2 million people; no active-user definition
documented_features: Basic limited budgets/entries; paid export, print, reminders and sync on four platforms. No subscription was started.
product_implication: A simple list is a serious baseline; core handover must remain free and exportable.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: Money Manager by Realbyte
adoption_evidence: Provider states 20M+ downloads, 270k reviews, 4.7 rating
documented_features: Category budgets, calendar, charts, receipt photos and double-entry features. Numbers are provider claims, not German-market or outcome evidence.
product_implication: Do not call receipt photography or monthly totals a unique feature.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: Undebt.it
adoption_evidence: Provider claims hundreds of thousands helped and billions paid down; unaudited
documented_features: Snowball/avalanche and six other orderings, payments, extra payments and public calculator; new bank sync/installable web app described.
product_implication: Debt-free projections require assumptions; exclude automatic priority advice from a German preparation tool.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: Debt Payoff Planner
adoption_evidence: Provider states 1M+ downloads and 4.7 rating
documented_features: Balance/APR/minimum input, strategy comparison, visual progress and multi-device access. User surveys/testimonials do not establish causal benefit.
product_implication: Appointment preparation is distinct from payoff gamification; assess real user preferences before claims.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: GnuCash
adoption_evidence: Maturity/community established; adoption not quantified
documented_features: Open-source double-entry accounts, reports, QIF/OFX/HBCI, scheduling and financial calculations; current homepage offers 5.17.
product_implication: Accuracy, local files and reports already exist; avoid accounting complexity for one appointment.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: HomeBank
adoption_evidence: Provider describes 28 years of feedback; not user count
documented_features: Imports/exports, category splits, scheduling, duplicate suggestions and reconciled-change protection.
product_implication: Duplicate detection is established; distinguish claim/collector linkage from transaction deduplication.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: KMyMoney
adoption_evidence: KDE community provenance; no adoption metric checked
documented_features: Cross-platform personal-finance manager with double-entry principles; ease-of-use and accuracy are stated goals, not measured outcomes here.
product_implication: Use as an accounting alternative, not evidence of a counselling-preparation feature gap.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: Money Manager Ex
relationship: Local files, budgets and attachments baseline
adoption_evidence: No adoption metric checked
documented_features: Manual documents describe budgets, forecasting, imports/exports, attachments and encrypted .emb versus unencrypted .mmb databases. Android security docs conflict by version.
product_implication: App PIN is not database encryption; test version-specific recovery and data protection.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.

name: Firefly III
adoption_evidence: Primary repository indexed at 24.8k stars; interest proxy, not users
documented_features: Self-hosted budgets, recurring transactions, rules, reports, double-entry and optional 2FA; technical deployment required.
product_implication: Local/self-hosted finance already has strong options; low setup burden is a hypothesis to test.
effectiveness_assessment: No independent comparative outcome evidence verified for the German counselling-preparation task. Ratings, provider claims and testimonials do not establish effectiveness.
